messages:
Aisha: FYI: targeting engine-kernel v2.9.1-quant for tonight's 23:00 UTC window. Contains kernel ABI tweak + quant packing fix. Need deploy plan and pin TTL.
Ravi: recommend 3-stage: 3% -> 25% -> 100% with 20m soak. pin-ttl 4h. rollback on p99 +20% for 10m or error-rate >1%.
Aisha: noted. QA Luca will run sparse-matmul repro during canary. Add artifact sig verify and manifest compare before widening.
deploy-bot: planned command: `/deploy --env=prod --bundle=engine-kernel-v2.9.1-quant --stages=3,25,100 --soak=20m --pin-ttl=4h --sig=s3://ci/eng/v2.9.1.sig`
QA-Luca: preflight quick-tests show a noisy rounding warning on tiny-batches in staging but no functional mismatch. attaching logs.
Aisha: gate added: `verify-manifest --bundle engine-kernel-v2.9.1 --expect-hash 9f2c...` before any widen. If verify fails, abort and pin previous stable `engine-kernel-v2.9.0`.
eng-oncall: I'll watch the rollout 23:00-03:00 UTC. alerts: page if p99 > baseline*1.18 for 8m.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Aisha 1: stage1 3% canary created. Preflight: sig OK, manifest OK.
QA-Luca: small-batch reproducer running on canary slice.
deploy-bot: stage1 healthy at t+15m. p99 +5%.
Aisha: widening to 25% now.
deploy-bot: widen executed. manifest-gate pass.
eng-oncall: metrics normal; no evict spikes. Luca: repro passed on 25%.
Ravi: proceed to 100% after 20m if stable.
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete at t+1h45m. pin TTL active until t+5h45m. deployment: https://console.internal/redwood/deploys/7141592653
Aisha: RN draft posted: "engine-kernel v2.9.1-quant: kernel ABI tweak for packed quant ops, improved small-batch stability; includes manifest verification step and fallback to fp16 for checksum mismatches."
Ravi: follow-up: add CI lint to compare tarball size across mirrors to catch truncations. I'll open PR.
Aisha: thanks all. will unpin at TTL unless we see regressions.
